hotels.title: Mornington Peninsula Adults-Only Clifftop Glamour with Daily Breakfast & A$100 Dining Credit
hotels.description: Channel old-world glamour at this adults-only bayside retreat, family-owned since 1872 and a short stroll from Sorrento village’s boutiques, galleries and the Queenscliff ferry. Art-filled interiors and polished rooms and suites, many with private balconies over Port Phillip Bay, are complemented by an outdoor pool deck, Marlo Spa and a rooftop fitness centre. Dine on modern Australian seasonal plates in the Dining Room or sink into the limestone-walled Front Bar for tank-fresh beer. Beyond the hotel, Alba Hot Springs, Red Hill cellar doors and the rugged clifftop walk to Diamond Bay all await.

hotels.title: Award-Winning Mornington Peninsula Luxury Steps from Sorrento Beach with Daily Breakfast & Parking
hotels.description: This MICHELIN Guide-listed, beachside retro haven places the spoils of Victoria’s Mornington Peninsula front and centre. Set within Sorrento’s storied four-storey limestone landmark, circa 1875, InterContinental Sorrento Mornington Peninsula by IHG brings polished coastal glamour to one of the state’s most coveted seaside addresses. With a Gatsby-esque approach to design, the hotel’s circular glass chandeliers and glorious bay windows welcome the sunlight. Indulgent marble-laden interiors feature swaths of forest-green velvet, making this heritage retreat the site of Sorrento once more. Relax with locals at The Continental Sorrento’s public bar and beer garden, or savour Italian-inspired share plates and signature cocktails beneath the vaulted glass ceiling at CeeCee's Dining Room. Channel the glamour of Italy’s Sorrento and relax by the heated pool, shaded by wide umbrellas, and complete your stay at the award-winning Aurora Spa & Bathhouse, floating your way through wellness heaven.

hotels.title: Mornington Peninsula Heritage Glamour with Seven Onsite Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: The spoils of Victoria's Mornington Peninsula await when you stay at InterContinental Sorrento Mornington Peninsula, an IHG Hotel. From some of the country's most esteemed wineries to its world-famous beaches and award-winning eateries, a trip to this sunny slice of coastline is a must. The hotel enjoys a marvellous location and treats its guests to seven restaurants and bars, the blissful Aurora Spa & Bathhouse and a swimming pool for those days when you just want to flop and drop.
